questions.question: What is the text colour of the paragraph?
questions.explanation: The selector `#main p` has specificity (0,1,0,1), which is higher than `.intro` (0,0,1,0) and `p` (0,0,0,1). Red wins.

questions.question: With `box-sizing: content-box; width: 200px; padding: 10px; border: 5px solid;` what is the total rendered width of the element?
questions.explanation: content-box: width applies to content only. Total width = 200 (content) + 10+10 (padding) + 5+5 (border) = 230px.

questions.question: What colour will the link be on hover?
questions.correctOutput: inherit (which will be black, or maybe purple? Actually `inherit` takes the value from the parent. If the parent's color is, say, default black, it will be black. Without further context, it will inherit the parent's color. The parent body probably default black. So answer 'black' or 'inherit'.)
questions.correctAnswer: black (or inherit from parent, which is typically black)
questions.explanation: `a.special:hover` has specificity (0,0,2,0), which is higher than `a:hover` (0,0,1,1). But the value is `inherit`, so it takes the colour of its parent element. Assuming parent `body` has default color, it becomes black.

questions.question: What is the final font size of the paragraph?
questions.explanation: html font size 20px. body inherits? No, body has font-size: 0.8em (relative to parent html, which is 20px) → 16px. p has 1.2em relative to body 16px → 16 * 1.2 = 19.2px.

questions.question: What margin separates the two paragraphs?
questions.correctOutput: 20px (only the larger of the two margins, because vertical margins collapse)
questions.explanation: Each paragraph has a top and bottom margin of 20px. When adjacent vertical margins meet, they collapse: the resulting margin is the larger of the two (20px), not 40px.

questions.question: Will the `::after` pseudo‑element be visible?
questions.correctOutput: Yes, a red 50x50 block will appear after the paragraph.
questions.explanation: Even though `content` is empty, the `::after` pseudo‑element is generated because `content` is explicitly set (to empty string). It then becomes a visible block with background.
